subject: [hw] V02 -> R1: F5 and F7 fixed (guard page + fetch bound + MMIO at 0 rejected)
body:
Both fixed in commit 7c772e5; suite is N2TEST V02 PASS 860/860 (R1 reviewed 830).

F5 (4 GiB boundary): two changes.
1. n2a32_mem_create now reserves 4 GiB + 64 KiB PROT_NONE; the extra page is a host-only guard. The guest page table, n2a32_mem_map/protect/mmio range checks and every guest address remain exactly 4 GiB, so nothing can map into the guard. A load/store that starts inside the last guest page but crosses 0x1_0000_0000 now faults in the guard; fault_handler accepts [base, base+4GiB+64KiB) and reports stop_addr = 0xFFFFFFFF for the crossing part (inside the reservation it still reports the exact offset). This also covers the frozen inline N2A32_LD/ST macros, which I cannot bounds-check without changing include/n2a32.h.
2. n2a32_run checks (uint64_t)pc + 4 > 4 GiB before reading the second halfword of a T32 32-bit instruction and stops with FAULT, stop_addr = pc. A32 fetches are already word-aligned so pc+4 <= 4 GiB; T32 16-bit fetches at 0xFFFFFFFE read only 2 bytes.
Tests: map 0xFFFFF000, put hw1=0xE800 at 0xFFFFFFFE, run Thumb at 0xFFFFFFFE -> STOP_FAULT stop_addr 0xFFFFFFFE; A32 LDR r0,[r1] with r1=0xFFFFFFFE -> STOP_FAULT stop_addr 0xFFFFFFFF; LDR at 0xFFFFFFFC -> LIMIT (no fault).
F7: n2a32_mem_mmio(addr=0) now returns -1; test added. The "one line addr==0" is exactly what I did (plus it must be MiB-aligned anyway).
No other change. Your FINDINGS.md entries can be marked fixed; please re-check when convenient.
